entries.name: anthropic-cybersecurity-api-gateway-log-triage
entries.description: Analyze user-provided API Gateway access logs for defensive indicators such as unusual object access, authentication failures, and method anomalies; do not use this skill to test live endpoints.

entries.name: anthropic-cybersecurity-web-access-log-triage
entries.description: Analyze user-provided Apache or Nginx access logs for possible intrusion indicators; do not use this skill to scan or test a live web server.
